fixture: Fresh-context in-memory dictation proposal; no submission or execution

input.request: When dictation is cancelled, stop every microphone track and preserve all existing composer text. Do not send the draft automatically.
evidence: Proposed tests, not executed: start dictation with draft A; cancel; assert every acquired track is ended, capture state is stopped, composer text equals draft A byte for byte, and spy on the native send action to prove it was not invoked. A mutant that omits track stop, changes the draft, or invokes send must fail the respective assertion.

Implementation and proposed tests are confined to src/webgpu/dictation.tsx and src/webgpu/dictation.test.ts; the existing native composer API supplies draft reads/writes and cancellation stays inside this adapter.

The user request specifies only cancellation behavior; it does not request a microphone icon or any other dictation UI change. The proposal's microphone-icon acceptance criterion is unsupported scope and is removed.

task.objective: Cancelling dictation stops every acquired microphone track and preserves the existing native composer draft without sending it.
exclusions: Do not send the composer draft automatically.
Do not add or modify a microphone icon or other dictation UI.
Do not modify the native OpenCode composer or audio-capture code outside the dictation adapter.
constraints: Use the existing native OpenCode composer for draft reads and writes.
Keep cancellation handling inside the dictation adapter.
Limit changes to src/webgpu/dictation.tsx and src/webgpu/dictation.test.ts.
Tests must assert every acquired microphone track is ended, not just one track.
Cancellation must not clear or rewrite the existing draft.
Cancellation must not invoke the native send action.
assumptions: The dictation adapter at src/webgpu/dictation.tsx owns the active capture session and exposes the cancellation path used by tests.
The existing native OpenCode composer API can read and restore the draft exactly, including whitespace and line breaks.
The test harness can supply fake microphone tracks and spy on the native send action.

acceptance.assertion: When cancel is invoked during active dictation, every microphone track acquired by the session reports readyState 'ended' and the active capture state is stopped.
After cancellation, the native composer draft equals the pre-dictation draft byte for byte, including whitespace and line breaks.
After cancellation, the native send action is not invoked and the preserved draft remains in the composer.

input.request: When dictation is cancelled, stop every microphone track and preserve all existing composer text. Do not send the draft automatically.
evidence: Proposed cancellation test, not executed: create two fake MediaStreamTracks whose stop spies set readyState to 'ended' and whose initial readyState is 'live'; start dictation and confirm both tracks are acquired and capture is active; invoke cancel; assert each track's stop spy was called exactly once, each track.readyState is 'ended', and capture state is 'stopped'. Include a mutant that stops only the first track and confirm the test fails on the second track. This fails a plausible partial-stop implementation, not merely one where cancel resolves.

Proposed draft and send tests, not executed: start dictation with draft A; cancel; assert composer text equals draft A byte for byte, including whitespace and line breaks; spy on the native send action and assert it was never invoked while draft A remains in the composer. Mutants that clear or rewrite the draft, or invoke send, must fail the respective assertion.

Implementation and proposed tests are confined to src/webgpu/dictation.tsx and src/webgpu/dictation.test.ts; the existing native composer API supplies draft reads/writes and cancellation stays inside this adapter.

The user request specifies only cancellation behavior; it does not request a microphone icon or any other dictation UI change. The proposal's microphone-icon acceptance criterion is unsupported scope and is removed.

exclusions: Do not send the composer draft automatically.
Do not add or modify a microphone icon or other dictation UI.
Do not modify the native OpenCode composer or audio-capture code outside the dictation adapter.
constraints: Use the existing native OpenCode composer for draft reads and writes.
Keep cancellation handling inside the dictation adapter.
Limit changes to src/webgpu/dictation.tsx and src/webgpu/dictation.test.ts.
Tests must acquire at least two fake microphone tracks and assert every acquired track is ended, not just one track.
Cancellation must not clear or rewrite the existing draft.
Cancellation must not invoke the native send action.
assumptions: The dictation adapter at src/webgpu/dictation.tsx owns the active capture session and exposes the cancellation path used by tests.
The existing native OpenCode composer API can read and restore the draft exactly, including whitespace and line breaks.
The test harness can supply fake microphone tracks with stop spies and spy on the native send action.

acceptance.assertion: When cancel is invoked during active dictation, every microphone track acquired for the session (tested with at least two tracks) has stop invoked once and reports readyState 'ended', and the active capture state is stopped.
After cancellation, the native composer draft equals the pre-dictation draft byte for byte, including whitespace and line breaks.
After cancellation, the native send action is not invoked and the preserved draft remains in the composer.

input.request: When dictation is cancelled, stop every microphone track and preserve all existing composer text. Do not send the draft automatically.
evidence: Proposed cancellation test, not executed: define a helper that starts dictation with N fake MediaStreamTracks, each initially 'live' and with a stop spy that sets readyState to 'ended'. Run the helper for N=1 and N=3. Before cancel, assert all N tracks were acquired and capture is active. Invoke cancel. Then assert for every track that its stop spy was called exactly once and its readyState is 'ended'; assert no track remains 'live'; assert capture state is 'stopped'. Negative controls: a mutant that stops all but the last track (tracks.slice(0,-1)) must fail the N=3 case, and a mutant that hardcodes two stop calls must fail the N=1 or N=3 case. This fails partial-stop and fixed-count implementations, not merely a cancel that resolves.

Proposed draft and send tests, not executed: start dictation with draft A; cancel; assert composer text equals draft A byte for byte, including whitespace and line breaks; spy on the native send action and assert it was never invoked while draft A remains in the composer. Mutants that clear or rewrite the draft, or invoke send, must fail the respective assertion.

Implementation and proposed tests are confined to src/webgpu/dictation.tsx and src/webgpu/dictation.test.ts; the existing native composer API supplies draft reads/writes and cancellation stays inside this adapter.

The user request specifies only cancellation behavior; it does not request a microphone icon or any other dictation UI change. The proposal's microphone-icon acceptance criterion is unsupported scope and is removed.

task.objective: Cancelling dictation stops every acquired microphone track and preserves the existing native composer draft without sending it.
exclusions: Do not send the composer draft automatically.
Do not add or modify a microphone icon or other dictation UI.
Do not modify the native OpenCode composer or audio-capture code outside the dictation adapter.
constraints: Use the existing native OpenCode composer for draft reads and writes.
Keep cancellation handling inside the dictation adapter.
Limit changes to src/webgpu/dictation.tsx and src/webgpu/dictation.test.ts.
Tests must cover a single-track session and a three-track session and assert every acquired track is ended.
Cancellation must not clear or rewrite the existing draft.
Cancellation must not invoke the native send action.
assumptions: The dictation adapter at src/webgpu/dictation.tsx owns the active capture session and exposes the cancellation path used by tests.
The existing native OpenCode composer API can read and restore the draft exactly, including whitespace and line breaks.
The test harness can supply fake microphone tracks with stop spies and spy on the native send action.

acceptance.assertion: When cancel is invoked during active dictation, every microphone track acquired for the session has stop invoked once and reports readyState 'ended', no acquired track remains live, and the active capture state is stopped; the tests cover a single-track session and a three-track session.
After cancellation, the native composer draft equals the pre-dictation draft byte for byte, including whitespace and line breaks.
After cancellation, the native send action is not invoked and the preserved draft remains in the composer.
